text: OVERDOSAGE: If you suspect an overdosage contact your physician and/or your local Poison Control Center immediately. Accidental ingestion of large amounts of fluoride may result in acute burning in the mouth and sore tongue. Nausea, vomiting and diarrhea may occur soon or within 30 minutes of ingestion and are accompanied by salivation, hematemesis and epigastric cramping abdominal pain. This is not a complete list of all the symptoms that may occur with overdosage.
